tools.name: get_day
tools.description: Everything on one day: work shifts, classes, tasks and what the shifts earned.

tools.name: get_shifts
tools.description: Work shifts in a date range with job, start and end time and, if allowed, the money each shift earned.

tools.name: get_classes
tools.description: Classes (university or school timetable) in a date range: subject, time, room, teacher, homework, materials (links); subjects the user marked closed, with their result; and materials attached to whole subjects.

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Tasks with a date in a date range, done or not, and open tasks without a date (inbox, newest first, up to 50).

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: Money earned by work shifts in a date range, in total and per job (overtime included), before tax; net after tax and fixed salary when the person set them. Default: this month so far.

tools.name: change_tasks
tools.description: Add, change, complete or reopen a task in DayHeart. add needs a title (date and time optional; time needs a date). update changes the title, date, time, length, important or urgent. complete marks the task done; reopen marks it not done. Notes and private tasks are not available.

tools.name: change_study
tools.description: Change the user's timetable and homework in DayHeart. add_class adds a class once, every week or every other week until a date. add_homework adds homework on a new line of a class's homework (the same text is not added twice). set_homework replaces it with a short line (what and for when) and option

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete a task or a class from DayHeart for good. This cannot be undone; in a shared group timetable the class disappears for the whole group.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "change_tasks" stacks urgency/override words (important, urgent). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Add, change, complete or reopen a task in DayHeart. add needs a title (date and time optional; time needs a date). update changes the title, date, time, length,…

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "delete" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
